ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark-grey and black pixels across >90% of the visible surface with sparse, localized high-intensity white/light-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed light-grey mottling concentrated around the medial regions of both lobes near the central notch; sparse white stippling distributed across the distal regions of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct rectangular excision on the inner-trailing edge of the left lobe; jagged peaks on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve transitioning to a shallow concave sweep near the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of approximately 6 circular high-contrast white pixel groups on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks; three parallel diagonal marks on the mid-right lobe and several horizontal scratches across the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant notch/missing tissue segment located on the inner-trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
